origine_fr: L'homme 亻 et 敖, écrit 龶, 万, 𠂉 et 乂, qui donne le son. 敖 se lit áo, la syllabe de ào. 傲 veut dire « arrogant » : celui qui toise les autres.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 敖, written 龶, 万, 𠂉 and 乂, which gives the sound. 敖 is read áo, the same syllable as ào. 傲 means “arrogant”: someone who looks down on others.

phrase.zh: 他很高傲，不跟别人说话。
phrase.pinyin: Tā hěn gāo'ào, bù gēn biéren shuōhuà.
phrase.fr: Il est très hautain, il ne parle pas aux autres.
phrase.en: He's very haughty and won't talk to anyone.
